### 🚀 Core Features
- ✅ **Multi-Tab Browsing** - Open multiple tabs simultaneously
- ✅ **Bookmarks** - Save and manage your favorite websites
- ✅ **History** - Track your browsing history
- ✅ **Dark/Light Theme** - Choose your preferred theme
- ✅ **Keyboard Shortcuts** - Navigate faster with shortcuts

### 🎯 Advanced Features
- 🔒 **Secure** - Built with security in mind
- 📥 **Download Manager** - Track and manage downloads
- 🕵️ **Incognito Mode** - Browse privately
- 🔍 **Smart Search** - Search directly from URL bar
- 📱 **Responsive** - Works on all screen sizes

### ⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| `Ctrl+T` | New Tab |
| `Ctrl+W` | Close Tab |
| `Ctrl+D` | Bookmark Page |
| `Ctrl+L` | Focus URL Bar |
| `Ctrl+H` | History |
| `Ctrl+Shift+H` | Show History |
| `Ctrl+=` | Zoom In |
| `Ctrl+-` | Zoom Out |
| `Ctrl+0` | Reset Zoom |
| `F12` | Developer Tools |

## 🚀 Installation

### Prerequisites
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (v18 or higher)
- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)

### Clone and Install

# Install electron-builder
npm install electron-builder --save-dev

# Build for current platform
npm run build

# Build for specific platform
npm run build:linux   # Linux
npm run build:win     # Windows
npm run build:mac     # macOS
# Fork and clone
git clone https://github.com/your-username/universal-browser.git
cd universal-browser

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Create a branch
git checkout -b feature/your-feature

# Make changes and commit
git add .
git commit -m "Description of changes"

# Push and create PR
git push origin feature/your-feature
